issues.description: No disk quota or max-file limit; continuous real-time operation will rapidly exhaust storage.
Missing invalidation policy (TTL/LRU); cache entries are never purged, violating real-time memory/disk constraints.
Stale data risk: outdated cache files persist indefinitely on disk and are only bypassed via version/conf checks, not removed.
Cache key uses MD5 of raw frame bytes; minor sensor noise or compression artifacts cause complete hash divergence, reducing hit rates in live streams.
